compiled_state.title: Create pre-commit hook wiring for design-md-lint.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-3: The pre-commit hook calls design-md-lint.sh and blocks commits that introduce violations in diff-touched lines

## Implementation
Create plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh as a thin wrapper that:
1. Resolves CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
2. Delegates to plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh
3. Propagates exit code (non-zero blocks the commit)
4. Registers in .pre-commit-config.yaml as a local hook entry matching the pattern used by pre-commit-test-gate.sh and pre-commit-review-gate.sh

chmod +x the hook file immediately after creation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Hook file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] Hook delegates to design-md-lint.sh and propagates exit code
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-design-md-lint.sh
- [ ] .pre-commit-config.yaml contains local hook entry for design-md-lint
  Verify: grep -q 'design-md-lint' .pre-commit-config.yaml
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_design_md_lint_hook] for plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_design_md_lint_hook\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
